title: Blozhik tRPC API + Database + Code Map

entry.description: Express server entry: configures CORS, security headers, tRPC middleware at /api/trpc, SSE /api/notifications/stream, sitemap/robots endpoints, Vite in dev and static serving in prod, scheduler for scheduled posts.

coreModules.description: tRPC init, transformer (superjson), logging middleware and procedure shortcuts: publicProcedure, protectedProcedure, adminProcedure.
Creates tRPC request context by authenticating requests via SDK; provides { req, res, user } to procedures.
Main appRouter: all tRPC routers (auth, user, post, comment, admin, analytics, etc.) with input Zod schemas and resolvers.
Database layer (drizzle + better-sqlite3): connection management and high-level DB operations used by routers (users, posts, comments, notifications, admin funcs, etc.).
Integration with external OAuth/session provider: exchange tokens, fetch user info, create/verify session JWTs and authenticate requests.
Audit logging helpers: log actions, errors, API requests and unauthorized access to audit_logs table.
Real-time notification hub (SSE) used to subscribe/unsubscribe and publish notifications to connected clients.
S3 helper: signed upload URLs for avatars and post images (used by user and post upload endpoints).
OAuth route registration and helper endpoints for OAuth callbacks (registered by entry).
Middleware to guard against malformed URI sequences in request paths.

notes.apiBasePath: /api/trpc (tRPC) and several REST endpoints for SSE and SEO)
notes.dbDefaultPath: ./blozhik.db or set DATABASE_URL / DATABASE_PATH env vars

shared.purpose: Common constants, permission definitions and shared types used across client and server.

modules.description: Global constants (cookie name, timeouts, error messages, etc.).
Permission and role definitions, default role permissions and helpers to check permissions.
Shared TypeScript types used by both client and server (if present).
Shared error constructors/helpers used by server SDK and middleware.

shared.usage: Used by server/_core modules (trpc, sdk, db) and by client code to keep contracts consistent (roles, permissions, messages).
